edition.tagline: Mailroom by day. Executive by night.
edition.cue: Serve the mains when Brantley changes from mailroom clothes to his suit in the lift.

s.how: Butter 8 slices of white bread with 30g softened butter. Layer 120g leg ham, 80g cheddar and 50g thinly sliced pickles across four slices. Top with the other slices, trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into three fingers. Wrap in baking paper and refrigerate until serving.

Cut the kernels from 2 corn cobs, about 200g. Whisk 80g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 60ml milk into a thick batter. Stir in the corn, 2 thinly sliced spring onions and 1/4 tsp salt. Heat 3 tbsp neutral oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Shallow-fry 8 spoonfuls of batter in batches for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain and serve with 100g sour cream for dipping.

m.how: Pat dry four 200g rib eye steaks. Sprinkle evenly with 1 tsp fine salt and refrigerate uncovered for 4 to 12 hours to dry-brine. Heat a heavy pan over high heat with 1 tbsp neutral oil. Sear the steaks for about 3 minutes per side, cooking in batches. Lower the heat, add 50g butter, 4 thyme sprigs and 3 lightly crushed garlic cloves. Baste repeatedly for 1 to 2 minutes. For medium rare, remove at 54°C in the centre; cook longer if preferred. Rest 8 minutes, then slice and spoon over the pan butter.

w.note: home on the farm in Kansas
w.how: Line a 20cm pie dish with half of 400g sweet shortcrust pastry. Peel, core and slice 600g Granny Smith apples, then toss with 80g caster sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon. Fill the crust, cover with the remaining pastry and crimp. Cut steam vents, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tsp extra sugar. Bake at 190°C conventional for 50 minutes until golden and tender. Rest 20 minutes, divide into four portions and serve with 200ml vanilla ice cream.

d.note: the weekend party where everyone's in the wrong bedroom
d.how: Freeze four martini glasses for 15 minutes. Working in two batches, stir a total of 240ml gin and 40ml dry vermouth with 400g ice for 30 seconds per batch. Strain equally into the frozen glasses. Cut four thin twists from 1 lemon, express their oils over the drinks and garnish each with a twist.
